modules: art/species-construction/fan_lock_sweeps_assembled.py (copy of fan_lock_sweeps_v3.py: cup and tuft off, per-column window weight)
interface: blender art/species-construction/finish_fan_assembled.py -- --asm <assembly dir> --out <new assembly dir> --table specs/r03_clumps.json --envelope specs/r03_envelope.npz --spec specs/r03_fan_assembled.json [--voxel .0016] [--mode locks|passthrough] [--sides L,R] [--p dotted.path=value ...]. Outputs akinza.blend, akinza.glb, assembly.json (skin counts), fan-assembled.json, stage-start.json, source-snapshot/.

parameters.name: voxel
parameters.what: fine voxel, head-local (the method asks .0008; a wing crop is 135M voxels at .0016, so finer needs a tiled build)

parameters.name: window.uMin / yMax
parameters.what: window edge in fit units: inner edge |u| and bottom row; every depth inside is replaced

parameters.name: window.cupMargin / cupInflate
parameters.what: edits have weight 0 inside the measured cup hull plus this

parameters.name: window.cupFade
parameters.what: edits fade in over this distance outside each cup hull plus cupMargin (fit units); small values leave a cliff around the cup (a box in the head-top view)

parameters.name: window.seamBlend
parameters.what: edits fade in over this distance inside the window edge

parameters.name: window.patchMargin
parameters.what: the fine patch stops this far (head-local) from the coarse hole boundary

parameters.name: strip.*, backing.*, layers[].standoff/undercut/lengthScale, section.*, tips.*, union.*, clumps, skip
parameters.what: the v3 lock sweep levers, unchanged meaning (see the author_fan_lock_sweeps_v3.py docstring)

parameters.name: coarseVoxel
parameters.what: level set of the unedited skin that fills window columns the edits do not reach (.004 gave a blobby patch)

parameters.name: tips.minHalfWidth / minHalfThick / leafA
parameters.what: blunter lock tips; the v3h values (.0035, 1.4) read as a fringe of needles at the .0016 voxel

checks.build: assembled-2820 from recipes/tool-R03.json via recipe.py candidate (A-fan 10.7 min; 15.7 min total)
checks.passthrough control: mode passthrough: window resample and zipper alone leave no visible change (head-top clean)
checks.measured: R03.1 1.021 to 1.015, R03.2 .0358 to .0389 (bound .06), I09 1.8543 to 1.8506 (bound 1.8605), all pass; R06.10, R07.6, R08.10, R08.11, R09.9, R10.2 fail in the baseline as well (not touched)
checks.containment: within allowance (picture change R01 .0128, R03 .0128, R04 .0128; the window overlaps the R01 and R04 crops)
checks.not run: recipe.py sweep (post steps are not sweepable; use plan variants with set edits on A-fan), and loop_tools quick separately (candidate ran the measured diff)

notes: Session 2 fixed the head-top box (edits stopped at a cliff around the cup hull: new window.cupFade), the inner-edge vertical step (uMin .075, seamBlend .05, strip.u [.075,.095]), the needle fringe (blunter tips) and the figure height. Design change from the method: the window is an axis box in x and z replacing every depth, and the cup and pale tuft are protected by edit weight 0 inside the cup hull plus cupMargin (an annulus window did not pair its hole loops). The cup and tuft are resampled, not resealed. Known remaining: the lower and outer fan edge still carries thin lock tips and a few thin slivers near the top outer edge, and the side view shows a row of small slabs in the fan face; builders should tune tips.*, section.widthScale, layers[].lengthScale and strip.yBlend.
